sentences.en: Why should he feel drowsy whenever he begins to study?
sentences.zh: 为什么他一开始学习就感到昏昏欲睡？

sentences.en: Why does he become drowsy whenever he begins to study?
sentences.zh: 为什么他一开始学习就会变得昏昏欲睡？

sentences.en: Ziri gave Rima some food that made her really drowsy.
sentences.zh: 齐里给了丽玛一些食物，让她感到非常困倦。

senses.zh: 昏昏欲睡的，困倦的；令人松弛的，令人困倦欲睡的；（尤指地方）静谧的，平静的，安静的
